verdict.rationale: Snyk documents its own event-driven automation: Snyk Studio's default hooks-based approach in agentic development environments checks code written by AI coding assistants, and Snyk supports PR-based fix workflows. There is no evidence of a user-defined rule engine that maps events to chosen actions. 'Policy management' appears only as a bare plan line item, and IaC custom Rego rules are detection rules, not event triggers. Missing for 10: user-authored event→action rule definitions, a documented catalog of trigger events and actions, configurable conditions, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Snyk Studio supports a default hooks-based approach for some agentic development environments (ADEs) to ensure code written by AI coding assistants is secure at inception (SAI)
supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests
